name: @kasane/post-004-experiments
description: Removable POST-004 research prototypes; not a supported contract.

scripts.build: pnpm --dir ../.. build && pnpm --dir ../../packages/watch build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir ../.. build && pnpm --dir ../../packages/watch build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm build && vitest run && node dist/scripts/type-benchmark.js --check && node dist/scripts/runtime-benchmark.js --check
scripts.bench: pnpm build && node dist/scripts/type-benchmark.js --check && node dist/scripts/runtime-benchmark.js --check
